about: Support matrix of portable packages (NAL-C3). ci: what tests/test_portable_smoke.py does on that platform in .github/workflows/portable.yml (tests/test_platform_support.py keeps both in step). local_models: whether a run with a bundled local model was checked. human: whether a person checked a package on real hardware of that platform. limits: known limits, by code (the studio and docs/portable-export.md explain each).
